text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"clear paragraphing with \"First of all,\" \"Second,\" \"Additionally\"","quality":"organization","description":"The essay groups ideas into distinct parts and uses transitions to show how the argument develops."},{"evidence":"specific examples like \"doodle on my paper\" and \"2D and 3D animation\"","quality":"concrete development","description":"The essay supports its points with more detailed, relevant examples rather than staying vague."},{"evidence":"\"it makes me less stressed out,\" \"find new styles,\" \"future career\"","quality":"idea clarity","description":"The essay states its main reasons in a more direct and understandable way."},{"evidence":"comparatively controlled sentences with fewer run-on fragments","quality":"sentence control","description":"The essay shows better control of sentence boundaries and overall sentence formation."},{"evidence":"\"new styles in my art,\" \"most enjoyable educational activity\"","quality":"word choice","description":"The essay uses more precise vocabulary that fits the topic and communicates meaning more effectively."}]}
